newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells 35-day T-bills, sets new auctions.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells 35-day T-bills, sets new auctions.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday it sold 65 million kuna through a new 35-day treasury bill issue priced at 98.956 kuna.
The accepted rate of 11 percent overshot the 9.5 percent for 120 million kuna in 91-day bills, issued on September 17.
Assistant Minister Hrvoje Radovanic told Reuters the ministry planned two more auctions, on October 8 for 91- and October 22 for 35-day T-bills again.
Today, it received bids for 70 milion kuna T-bills at prices between 99.381 and 98.862. Bid interest rates ranged between 6.50 and 12 percent, it said in a press release.
The bills are payable on October 3 and they mature on November 7.
Foreign investors have no direct access to T-bill auctions.
